_comment: CoDRAG Swarm Model Registry — Phase 79. Tight list of validated swarm-capable models. Kimi K2.5 is the primary supported model.

_tiers.coordinator: Can plan, decompose, and synthesize. Used as swarm coordinator.
_tiers.both: Can coordinate or work. Cost-effective all-rounder.
_tiers.unsuitable: Falls back to standard concurrent batching.

registry.notes: Primary supported swarm model. Designed for agent swarm from the ground up. Ollama cloud.
Versions 4.0 to 4.6 supported. Newer flagships (4.6) are extremely capable but can be cost overkill.
Structured outputs API forces valid JSON. Strong evals for 5.2, 5.3, 5.4.
Cost-effective for long-context coordination. 1M effective context.
NOT RECOMMENDED. Massive overkill and cost-prohibitive for the high token volume of agent swarms.
NOT RECOMMENDED. Claude Opus is cost-prohibitive for swarms.
